hypothesis: the relevant search state is the quotient transition graph between replay-valid continuation-interface classes, not literal term geometry

interface_identity.unit: set of replay-valid one-step source-law interaction descriptors

compatibility.rule: two interface classes are compatible iff some interaction from each class has the same source side, the same context-role shape, compatible partial substitutions on shared source variables, and neither interaction uses target/teacher information
compatibility.note: distance buckets are diagnostic and are not required to match for compatibility

transition_graph.source_nodes: the five generation-1 LHS continuation-interface classes and the single generation-1 RHS class reconstructed under the frozen parent protocol
transition_graph.edge: I -> J iff a replay-valid one-step source-law continuation from a term in class I reaches a term whose continuation interface is J
transition_graph.representative_policy: use all retained bounded terms in each class up to the frozen per-class cap; do not choose a representative using target distance

decision_table.INTERFACE_PATH_TO_RHS_COMPATIBILITY: a replay-valid class-transition path from an LHS class reaches an interface compatible with the frozen RHS class while structural distance need not contract
decision_table.INTERFACE_COMPATIBLE_AT_GENERATION1: at least one of the five LHS generation-1 classes is already compatible with the RHS class
decision_table.INTERFACE_TRANSITION_NO_COMPATIBILITY: transition graph grows but no LHS class reaches RHS compatibility under the frozen depth/bounds
decision_table.INTERFACE_QUOTIENT_STALL: little or no new class-transition structure is produced despite replay-valid syntactic continuations

scientific_rule: Do not promote a constructor from this diagnostic alone. If a compatible interface path is found, freeze that path's effect-level interface obligations and test a separate K-to-W causal admission gate.
